label: First Run — to $100K
audience_note: First-time founder. Gentler thresholds, more coaching surfaces, more context on why a question is being asked. Case studies skew to early-stage Southeastern founders.

_dial_docs.score_harshness: How strictly raw evidence is converted to score. 0.7 = First Run gentler (scores rise faster, fall slower).
_dial_docs.novelty_multiplier: How strongly the engine avoids repeating content. 1.0 = baseline novelty bias.
_dial_docs.max_surfaces_per_render: Cap on coaching cards shown at once. Lower = less overwhelming.
_dial_docs.contradiction_sensitivity: Threshold for flagging contradictions. 0.5 = only the most clear-cut.
_dial_docs.anti_pattern_severity_floor: Minimum severity_weight for an anti-pattern to surface. 0.6 = surface only the more important patterns; spare First Run founders the corner-case warnings.
